Ivy (Account Exec): Contoso ready to sign POC orderform. Procurement sent MSA/DPA redlines and a KMS requirement: they want customer-managed AWS KMS keys for the POC on our Hosted plan. They also asked for monthly committed spend instead of pure usage billing. Need legal + sec view before I respond. @Ravi @Nora @Liam
Ravi (Legal): Share their redline PDF here and any specific KMS clauses. We generally allow customer-managed CMKs only on Dedicated or Private; Hosted is Redwood-managed. I'll review redlines for indemnity/data transfer escalators.
Ivy (Account Exec): Uploaded: contoso_msa_redlines.pdf and contoso_syssec.docx. Procurement wants signer order: PO -> Contoso Legal -> Redwood Sales Ops -> Redwood Legal.
Nora (Security): Customer CMKs on multi-tenant Hosted is a hard no from SecOps. Risk: key isolation, tenant blast radius, key rotation policies. We can support CMKs on Dedicated/Private with attestation + onboarding checklist. If they insist, we need a Security Exception with controls: dedicated tenancy, KMS access audit, restricted key policies, quarterly key rotation proof.
Liam (Finance): Pricing ask: they propose a 12-month monthly commit with tiered usage and net60 payment terms. Our standard: net30; 12mo commits can get up to 6% discount. For net60 we need RevOps approval. What's the commit size?
Ivy (Account Exec): Commit proposal is ~$25k/mo. They asked for 10% off and net60.
Jules (Sales Ops): For DocuSign routing I need the final orderform PDF + list of signer emails. Also confirm if we require an exec signature for the POC.
Ravi (Legal): Quick position: Draft clause to include in MSA addendum: "Customer CMKs may be used only on Dedicated or Private deployments. Hosted deployments will use Redwood-managed keys. Any exception requires a documented Security Exception and operational onboarding." I'll flag any aggressive data transfer/indemnity language.
Nora (Security): If we open a Security Exception path, the minimum controls: 1) Dedicated tenancy, 2) KMS key policy lock to restrict to customer's account, 3) Operational runbook + emergency key revoke process, 4) Audit log forwarding to customer SIEM. Without those, we can't approve.
Liam (Finance): If we move the POC to Dedicated with those controls, I can approve net45 and 7% discount at $25k/mo commit. Net60 + 10% will need CRO sign-off.
Ivy (Account Exec): Contoso is sensitive to provisioning lead time. They want to start within a week. Can we provision Dedicated that fast?
Jules (Sales Ops): Typical Dedicated lead time is 48-96 hours once purchase approved. We need capacity check from Eng/Infra. Also confirm billing/legal route for prepaid vs monthly invoices.
Ravi (Legal): For DocuSign tag: "Legal - provisional acceptance; final after Security Exception approval." Also, we will not accept open-ended indemnity or worldwide data transfers. I'll mark specifics inline and return a redline response.
Nora (Security): Operational note: Dedicated for 25k/mo commit at POC scale ok, but SLA 99.95 requires reserved capacity and priority routing. Expect ~15-25% cost uplift for reserved nodes and monitoring.
Liam (Finance): I can approve net45/7% if Security agrees and Legal signs off. Otherwise escalate to RevOps/CRO for net60/10%.
Ivy (Account Exec): Proposed next steps: 1) Ravi posts legal reply with redline comments by EOD; 2) Nora posts security exception bucket & required checklist; 3) Jules prepares DocuSign envelope draft and confirms signing order; 4) Liam confirms finance concession or escalation path. Aim: reply to Contoso tomorrow AM.
Ravi (Legal): Will post redline response. If Contoso removes broad transfer/indemnity asks we can move quicker.
Nora (Security): I'll post minimal exception checklist and call out controls that must be attached to orderform.
Jules (Sales Ops): I'll draft DocuSign envelope with signer order: Contoso PO -> Contoso Legal -> Jules (Sales Ops) -> Ravi (Legal). Email addresses please. Also: include contoso_syssec.docx and contoso_msa_redlines.pdf.
deploy-bot: capacity-check.csv uploaded to shared drive: https://files.redwood.com/capacity-check.csv :white_check_mark:
Ivy (Account Exec): I'll collect signer emails and share. Thanks team. I'll ask Contoso if they'd accept Dedicated for POC to avoid the CMK impasse.
Liam (Finance): If Dedicated accepted, we can move faster on pricing.
Ravi (Legal): Note for Docs: please include "provisional" watermark until Security exception is fully approved.
Ivy (Account Exec): Understood. Ping me if anything blocks the EOD reply. :thumbsup:
